name: python-tests-for
about: A unittest file (test_solution.py) for your module that passes on it and catches at least min_killed of its mutants (flipped comparisons, constants off by one …).
instructions: Return only the unittest file. It imports from `solution`. Test the edges: boundaries, empty input, both sides of every condition.

code.about: the module to test, correct as it is

min_killed.about: share of mutants the tests must catch (0..1); some mutants can't be caught by any input, so 1.0 is rarely right
